text: Photocopy of valid passport With name, passport number & expiration date, and photo included Passport photo A recent passport-sized photo of the applicant Letter of guarantee The guardian should write out his/her name, nationality, occupation and address (if an organization acts as the guardian, reference to the organization should be made clear). Valid identity document of the applicant's guarantor For example, photocopy of ID card, photocopy of passport, etc.
